q_001.sql: SELECT c.name AS category, ROUND(SUM(t.amount), 2) AS total_spent FROM transactions t JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.category_id WHERE t.direction = 'expense' AND t.txn_date >= '2026-07-01' AND t.txn_date < '2026-08-01' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC

q_002.sql: SELECT m.name, s.plan_name, s.amount, s.next_renewal_date FROM subscriptions s JOIN merchants m ON s.merchant_id = m.merchant_id WHERE s.status = 'active' AND s.next_renewal_date >= '2026-08-03' AND s.next_renewal_date < date('2026-08-03', '+30 days') ORDER BY s.next_renewal_date
